original_case: Why does a midpoint receive weight four?
changed_condition: Try x to the fourth power on the same interval.
viewer_inference: The values differ. For general curves this is an approximation, improved by using more subintervals with suitable smoothness.
resolution: Simpson weights1,4,1 times width/6 integrate quadratics exactly; the same three-point estimate need not be exact for a quartic.
prerequisite: Representations and operations introduced in this film
